findings.text: a pair present in all three tiers but yielding no total in any of them (every tier's only row for the hour carries the counter with no earlier opening row, so _run_window_total returns None for all three) satisfies 'raw_total == minute_total == hour_total' as None == None and is counted in compared_pairs with agrees True; the pre-change code required raw_total is not None. A file whose every compared pair is all-None would be eligible on no evidence, contradicting 'a file is eligible only once at least one pair was compared'. Reproduced by writing one raw-shaped row per tier in a single hour: compared_pairs 1, agrees True, raw/minute/hour all None. Reachability in production turns on whether a compacted row always declares its counter's opening; production compaction does, which is why this is a follow-on rather than blocking -- but the boundary 'every compared pair has at least one computable total' is no longer asserted where the pre-change guard asserted it.
